Row 26: A="A note on the update schedule"; B="From September 2026, the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Act removed the presumption that new schools will be opened as free schools, instead allowing proposals for all types of new schools, including proposals from local authorities to open their own new school. To reflect these changes, which are anticipated to reduce the number of schools coming into the free schools pipeline, we have moved the update cycle for this publication from a monthly to a termly basis."
Row 27: A="A note on Trust details in the Pre-Opening tab"; B="Where a Trust withdraws from a project but a final decision is still to be taken about whether to transfer the project to another trust, we show details of the most recent appointed trust"
Row 28: A="A note on Cancelled / Withdrawn projects"; B="Projects are cancelled/withdrawn when there are significant concerns about a proposed school's viability, quality and/or site value for money"
Row 29: A="A note on dates"; B="The data are correct as of 1 September 2026, noting that schools can open for pupils during the month but are funded from the start of the month. For this data, we count such schools as 'open' from the 1st of the month"
Row 30: A="A note on Waves"; B="Free school applications are usually submitted during 'Wave' application rounds."
Row 31: A="A note on LA Special/AP competitions"; B="Once successful trusts have been confirmed by the Department for Education, the projects will enter the pre-opening phase of the programme and will be added to the Pre-Opening tab."
Row 32: A="A note on Mainstream Pipeline Review projects"; B="This tab shows the projects reviewed as part of the mainstream free school pipeline review announced in October 2024, which assessed 44 projects against the following criteria: evidence of need, value for money, and whether the school would provide a unique offer for students who would otherwise not access it, without damaging the viability of existing local schools and colleges.\n\nIt sets out the ministerial decisions for all mainstream projects. All decisions were finalised by 21 May 2026. It identifies which projects will proceed and which have been cancelled. Projects that are continuing are listed in the ‘Pre-Opening’ tab, and those that have been cancelled are listed in the ‘Cancelled or Withdrawn’ tab."
Row 33: A="A note on Special/AP projects under consideration"; B="This tab lists Special and AP projects announced in December 2025. It sets out the final decisions for all projects, which were completed by 21 May 2026. It identifies which projects will continue and which will receive alternative funding instead of the proposed school. Special and AP projects that are continuing are listed in the ‘Pre-Opening’ tab, and those that have been cancelled are listed in the ‘Cancelled or Withdrawn’ tab.\n\nA total of 77 Special and AP projects were considered for alternative funding rather than delivery of the proposed school. For most LAs, there was a choice to continue with the proposed school or accept alternative funding. For 18 projects where a trust had not yet been appointed, LAs were allocated alternative funding without a choice, as the projects were at an early stage and places could be delivered more quickly through funding. Six LAs submitted representations against the decision to receive direct funding; final ministerial decisions on these cases were included in the overall decisions concluded on 21 May 2026. This list includes only the 77 projects that were in scope of this process. Projects not shown here were not under consideration, including LA presumption projects."

claim.rendered_assertion_zh_hant_hk: 第26行：A為「關於更新時間表的說明」；B指由September 2026起，《兒童Wellbeing and Schools Act》取消了新學校將以自由學校形式開辦的推定，改為容許所有類型新學校的建議，包括地方當局開辦其本身新學校的建議。為反映這些預期會減少進入自由學校籌備管道的學校數目的改變，此刊物的更新周期已由每月改為每學期。
